turns.text: Haan, Sunita bol rahi hoon. Kya baat hai?
Abhi paise nahi hain, main nahi de sakti.
Maine bola na, paisa nahi hai. Baar baar call mat karo.
Exactly kitna baaki hai? Aur late fee kitni lagi hai?
Nahi, is mahine bilkul nahi hoga.
Aap log bas pareshan karte ho. Main nahi dungi.
Theek hai, 15 tareekh tak 10,000 try karungi, pakka nahi.
Bas, ab phone rakhiye.
